What links the observation of a rooster sound to the reasoned belief that it is dawn?

```{mcq}
#| label: d01-rooster-link
1. The heuristic rule that roosters crow at dawn. [correct]
2. The fact that dawn always occurs when a rooster makes a sound.
3. A formal proof that dawn has occurred.
4. A measurement of the time of day.
```
:::
